label: Diagram 1.6
caption: Diagram 1.6
description:
This diagram, titled "Diagram 1.6 Change of direction in flights", depicts a plan view of a staircase featuring a change of direction. The drawing is composed of three main connected parts: a first flight, a landing, and a second flight.

The first flight is shown on the left, consisting of four parallel lines representing steps. To its left, a dimension line indicates the "Stair width". This flight leads into a rectangular "Landing" area. A dimension line above the landing specifies that it must be "At least stair width".

The second flight departs from the right side of the landing at an angle. It consists of four parallel lines representing steps, oriented diagonally. The angle between the direction of the second flight and the first flight is labeled "Angle at least 30°". The text "See paras 1.17 and 1.20" is located in the top left corner of the diagram.
